## Probe #17 residual + tagged rebuild

Builds on **0.1.24** / tip `41b2c1a` (probe #16 mid-cycle). Inspection rounds since v0.1.24 reached 3 → tagged rebuild.

### Critical fix
- **Tab context menu under Xvfb** — right-click on editor tabs never showed Pin / Select for Compare / Compare with Selected even after the probe #16 scrollbar overlay removal. Unit tests registered the labels; Explorer’s menu worked. Root cause: declarative `.context_menu()` deferred its `PopupMenu` against Right `on_mouse_down` → `activate()` which `notify`s and deferred-focuses the editor, wiping pending element state before paint. Tabs now open an owned `PopupMenu` programmatically (same pattern as the title-bar menus), without stealing editor focus on that path. Shift+F10 / Menu key also open the menu.

### Soft
- **Edge-drag → second group** — mouse-up now treats the release point as authoritative for the 120px right/bottom strip (plus viewport fallback when body bounds never arrived), covering Xvfb cases where last drag-move lagged.

### Already accepted (unchanged)
Move-not-clone cross-group drops, dirty close Save/Don’t Save/Cancel when Auto Save is off, Compare body paint, Split Editor Right, Welcome, Terminal→Ctrl+P, Theme Esc, external reload, MD preview.
